recipes.label: Direct Assault!
recipes.startdescription: This one stepped straight forward, baring its fangs and claws—
recipes.description: Yet nothing comes forth. Something is off.

recipes.label: Enemy Concealed
recipes.startdescription: This one draws back, shielded by dust and shadow—
recipes.description: Let them flee. They should be glad they did not choose to press forward.

recipes.label: Seize the Assets!
recipes.startdescription:
The enemy circles to the flank, eyeing the supplies we have stored—

[Failing to withstand this attack will not cause injury, but will permanently remove one of your assets.]
recipes.description: Yet nothing comes forth. Something is off.

recipes.label: To Respond?
recipes.startdescription:
Enemies are acting here—can I strike back?

[Reach any threshold of the enemy to successfully defend.]

recipes.label: Defenseless!
recipes.description: I failed to muster enough strength to resist the enemy, and now I will pay the price—

recipes.label: Defenseless!
recipes.description: I failed to muster enough strength to resist the enemy, and now I will pay the price—

recipes.label: Unprepared!
recipes.startdescription: I cannot spare a hand to deal with the enemy from the flank—now the losses are spiraling out of control—
recipes.description: These assets can no longer be recovered.

recipes.label: Unleash the Wild Fury
recipes.startdescription: Blazing wrath seizes my mind and body, burning through every stray of soul and every inch of flesh—
recipes.description: While rage endures, this body cannot be felled. Those who scorn my power shall pay the price.

recipes.label: Respond with Force
recipes.startdescription: Speech was the weapon that won the first war. And the language of force speaks louder than words.

recipes.label: Respond with Revolution
recipes.startdescription: Arms as the hammer, battlefield as the anvil—here shall I kindle the fires of change.

recipes.label: Respond with Torment
recipes.startdescription: All living things yield to the lure of the Grail, yet its essence is torment. I shall prove it.

recipes.label: Respond with Ceaselessness
recipes.startdescription: The shadow of war is a contest of preservation, and my preservation will not end today.

recipes.label: Respond with Opening
recipes.startdescription: Nothing can truly be sealed shut. Their lives shall cross the threshold and spill outward.

recipes.label: Respond with Ruthlessness
recipes.startdescription: The Glory casts an indifferent gaze upon this place, and in its turn I shall deliver a judgment equally devoid of mercy.

recipes.label: Respond with Chaos
recipes.startdescription: Yearning is the spark that sets the soul ablaze, yet it may just as easily spiral into chaos. They will rush into the flames.

recipes.label: Respond with Silence
recipes.startdescription: Words end here. Even in silence there is power—a power that brings an end.

recipes.label: Cast the Trick That Perturbs Time
recipes.startdescription:
Time, a flame ever shifting. Paradoxical lore disrupts its undulation, warping its scale and stretching it—

[This will delay this attack for a time.]

recipes.label: Cast the Trick That Perturbs Time
recipes.startdescription: This cannot easily alter the ties of cause and effect, but at least it can buy me a little more time to prepare.

recipes.label: Enemy Repelled
recipes.description: Thus the enemy has been driven back.

recipes.label: Fading into Shadow
recipes.description: The enemy has been thwarted here, yet has seized the chance to retreat back into the shadows. How cunning.
